newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hamersley sets month iron ore export record.
newsitem.headline: Hamersley sets month iron ore export record.

text.p: Rio Tinto Plc/Ltd's iron ore subsidiary, Hamersley Iron Pty Ltd, set a new monthly export tonnage record in June, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.
"We exported 5.8 million tonnes in June, " said Hamersley's External Affairs General Manager Tony Finucane.
"That compares with the previous best of 5.6 million tonnes in August 1993."
Hamersley is wholly owned by of Rio Tinto and mines iron ore from five deposits in Western Australia's Pilbara region.
It recently announced plans to commence construction of a new mine at Yandicoogina later this year.
Finucane said the new monthly export tonnage record was reached on the evening of June 30 when the 70,000 tonnes Asia Angel sailed from Dampier bound for China.
